visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a highly detailed anthropomorphic bulldog wearing a beige bucket hat and a white tank top sitting on a red plastic stool. Next to him is an orange cat wearing a black jacket. They are positioned in front of a small charcoal grill filled with various meat skewers and a whole fish. The setting is a dimly lit outdoor night market with a blurred street background and a red sign with Chinese characters on the wall behind them. (2) The bulldog and the cat reach down to pick up two green glass beer bottles from a small red stool. The lighting is warm and cinematic, highlighting the textures of their fur and clothing. (3) The two characters clink their beer bottles together in a celebratory toast while smoke continuously rises from the skewers on the grill. (4) Both characters tilt the bottles back and take a drink simultaneously, with their eyes closed in an expression of satisfaction. (5) The bulldog picks up a small skewer and bites into it, while the cat picks up the large grilled fish and takes a large bite. The movement is smooth and cartoonish, emphasizing the enjoyment of the street food.
